title: Submenus of KStatusNotifierItem open to the wrong side
line: Submenus in tray icon context menus now open the first time you hover over them.
explanation: The system tray imports an app's menu over DBusMenu, and a submenu's items are only requested when Qt is about to show that submenu. The request is asynchronous, so on the first hover the submenu is still empty, and QMenu refuses to show an empty menu; when the items arrived nothing asked for it again, so it only appeared after hovering off and back. Submenus are still fetched lazily, but when a submenu's items arrive while its entry is still the active item of a visible parent menu, the importer re-activates that entry so Qt shows the now-filled submenu.

commits.message:
libdbusmenuqt: show a submenu once its items arrive

Submenu items are only fetched when the submenu is about to show, and
QMenu won't show an empty menu, so the first hover showed nothing. Show
the submenu once its items arrive if its entry is still hovered.

BUG: 442877

media.caption: Fresh app start: 'Height' hovered for 2.5 s, no submenu
Fresh app start: 'Height' submenu opens on the first hover
Then 'Width' hovered for 2.5 s: no submenu either
'Width' submenu opens on its first hover too
Before: first hovers of Height and Width show nothing
After: Height and Width open on their first hover
